message: I have a friend who always seems to panic at the first sign of trouble—like when the sky gets a little gray, she’s already gathering supplies and planning escape routes! 😅 It made me realize that while it's good to be prepared, staying calm and having a simple plan can make all the difference. I like to keep a go-bag ready and know where important documents are. What’s your go-to tip for staying ready without the frenzy?
